app.title: SimpleRPG
app.tagline: A realm that never noticed it isn't online.
title.subtitle: The Realm of Aethermoor awaits
title.deleteConfirmBody: This deletes the hero, their gear, and their spot in the Hall of Fame. There is no undo. Type the hero's name to confirm.
title.deleteNameMismatch: That's not their name. The clerk squints at you.
title.importHint: Paste a save code (SRPG1.…) or choose a .simplerpg file. It will occupy this slot.
title.slotOccupiedWarning: This slot already holds {name} — importing will overwrite them.
title.version: v{version} · planning docs in repo · no servers were harmed
create.title: Sign the adventurer's ledger
create.nameHelp: 2–16 characters. The Hall of Fame engraver charges by the letter.
create.nameTooShort: The engraver needs at least 2 letters.
class.warrior.name: Warrior
class.warrior.blurb: Hits things. Occasionally with a plan.
class.warrior.signature: Shield Block — 25% chance to block a hit entirely.
class.scout.name: Scout
class.mage.name: Mage
class.mage.blurb: Reads books so hard they explode.
class.mage.signature: Spells can't be blocked or evaded. Ever.
class.assassin.name: Assassin
class.assassin.signature: Strikes twice each round; crits up to 60%.
attr.str.name: Strength
attr.dex.name: Dexterity
attr.int.name: Intelligence
attr.con.name: Constitution
attr.lck.name: Luck
hud.vigorTooltip: Adventure energy — spent on missions and expeditions. Refills at midnight.
screen.tavern.title: The Gilded Tankard
screen.tavern.welcome: Marla Thistlebrew polishes a tankard and nods at the mission board.
screen.tavern.placeholderTitle: The mission board is being nailed up
screen.tavern.placeholderBody: Three patrons with questionable errands arrive in milestone M2 — timed missions, vigor, rewards, the works. The foundation you're looking at (shell, saves, frames) is milestone M0.
screen.character.title: Character
screen.character.placeholderBody: Attribute buying, gear and the backpack arrive with milestone M3. Your base attributes below are live from your save.
screen.locked.title: Locked
screen.locked.body: This part of Brambleford unlocks at level {level}.
settings.title: Settings
settings.noMusic: There is no music slider — v1.0 ships sound effects only. A slider that moves nothing is worse than one that isn't there.
settings.motionHelp: Switching them off keeps every number and skips every flourish. Nothing is hidden; it just stops moving.
settings.instantCombatHelp: Skip the blow-by-blow and go straight to who won.
settings.timersHelp: Ready in 12m, or ready at 14:32 — whichever your brain reads faster.

settings.credits.kenney: UI borders & VFX particles — Kenney (kenney.nl), CC0
settings.credits.gameicons: Icons — Lorc & Delapouite, game-icons.net, CC BY 3.0
settings.credits.fonts: Fonts — Cinzel & Nunito Sans, SIL Open Font License

toast.importFail.malformed: That code isn't a SimpleRPG save.
toast.importFail.checksum: That save code is damaged (checksum mismatch).
toast.importFail.futureVersion: That save is from a newer game version.
toast.deleted: {name} has retired to a quiet farm.
toast.helpSoon: Help overlays arrive with milestone M8.

zone.cinderpeak.name: Cinderpeak

hud.frozenBanner: Aethermoor's sun is confused — your device clock jumped backwards. Timers resume once time catches up.
tavern.busy: You're already out on a job
tavern.secondWindHint: Marla's on-the-house round: +50 vigor, once a day.
tavern.aleNone: The good barrel is empty until tomorrow.
tavern.zoneDecayHint: Older regions pay less, but their creatures and drops differ.
reveal.title: Mission complete!
reveal.levelUp: LEVEL UP! You are now level {level}.
reveal.autoSold: Backpack full — the innkeeper sold the spoils for {gold} gold.
patrol.title: City Watch
patrol.subtitle: Walk the walls of Brambleford until midnight. Gold trickles in every half hour.
patrol.locked: The Watch only hires exhausted adventurers — spend your vigor first. Union rules.
patrol.capWarning: Pockets full! Collect before the accrual cap eats your pay.
patrol.midnightNote: Patrol ends at midnight and banks itself.
patrol.tick.0: You confiscated a goblin's third juggling torch. Regulations.
patrol.tick.1: A cart of turnips tipped over. You supervised heroically.
patrol.tick.2: Someone asked directions to the Wishing Well. You pointed. Wages earned.
patrol.tick.3: You saluted the night baker. The night baker saluted back.
patrol.tick.4: A suspicious shadow turned out to be a very still cat.
patrol.tick.5: You polished your section of the wall. It's the shiniest section.
patrol.tick.6: Two pigeons fought over a crust. You declared a winner.
patrol.tick.7: You practiced your 'halt!' — startled a scarecrow.
patrol.tick.8: The moon looked lovely. You noted it in the logbook.
patrol.tick.9: A merchant tried to tip you in exposure. You accepted coin instead.
mission.generic.0: A farmer swears his scarecrow waved at him. Investigate. Wave back if appropriate.
mission.generic.1: Deliver this parcel. Do not shake it. It bites when shaken.
mission.generic.2: The innkeeper's cousin lost a bet and a boot. Recover at least the boot.
mission.generic.3: Escort a very slow turtle merchant past a very patient ambush.
mission.generic.4: Something keeps eating the tavern's deliveries. Marla wants names.
mission.generic.5: A wizard needs 'about a bucket' of stormwater. From the storm currently happening.
mission.generic.6: Put up 'BEWARE OF EVERYTHING' signs along the trade road.
mission.generic.7: A bard lost his lute mid-ballad. The audience insists it stay lost. Find it anyway.
mission.generic.8: Count the toll bridge's trolls. The number keeps changing.
mission.generic.9: Retrieve grandmother Odd's cauldron. Ignore whatever it's currently cooking.
mission.generic.10: The mayor's portrait was stolen. The mayor is mostly flattered. Mostly.
mission.generic.11: Someone taught the crows to haggle. Un-teach them.
mission.z1.0: The boars of Bramblewood have learned to queue. It's unsettling. Disperse them.
mission.z1.1: Tobbin the Toll-Troll now accepts exposure as payment. He'd prefer gold. Mediate.
mission.z1.2: A picnic went missing. The basket left a ransom note. Follow the crumbs.
mission.z1.3: The bee-wizard's swarm unionized. Attend the negotiation. Bring no jam.
mission.z1.4: Somebody keeps re-mossing the waterfall rocks overnight. Catch the decorator.
mission.z1.5: Walk widow Hettle's 'dog'. It is almost certainly a wolf. Do not mention this.
mission.z2.0: Millhaven's windmill turns the wrong way on Thursdays. Today is Thursday.
mission.z2.1: The scarecrows held an election. The turnip won. Supervise the transition.
mission.z2.2: A tax 'collector' with a fake mustache is working the farms. Collect him.
mission.z2.3: Old Man Mangel bet his farm on a ram fight. Referee it. Fairly-ish.
mission.z2.4: Crows have unionized with the Bramblewood bees. Cross-species solidarity. Trouble.
mission.z2.5: Someone's been harvesting fields in perfect spirals overnight. Leave a complaint.
mission.z3.0: Blossomvale's honey slimes have merged into one big polite slime. Un-merge it.
mission.z3.1: The garden gnomes rearranged themselves. Nobody moved them. Look into it.
mission.z3.2: A wasp baroness demands tribute in petals. The flowers object. Translate.
mission.z3.3: The groundskeeper hasn't been seen since the hedges 'got ambitious'. Prune. Rescue.
mission.z3.4: Pollen imps keep sneezing on the mail. The mail sneezes back now. Contain it.
mission.z3.5: Deliver a love letter between two rival orchards. Do not read it aloud. Again.
backpack.empty: Nothing but lint and one very patient moth.
itemAction.nothingEquipped: That slot is empty right now.
shops.title: Merchants of Brambleford
shops.weaponsmith.name: Weapon Smith
shops.weaponsmith.npc: Hammond Forgebright wipes soot on his apron: "Point the sharp end away from yourself."
shops.armorer.name: Armorer
shops.armorer.npc: Petra Stoutstitch sizes you up: "You'll dent nicely in that."
shops.arcanum.name: The Arcanum
shops.arcanum.npc: Zinnia Vex doesn't look up: "Touch nothing that hums."
shops.elixirFull: Drink sockets full — wait one out or replace a matching attribute.
forge.title: The Forge
forge.npc: Old Coalbeard squints at your gear: "I've seen worse. Barely."
forge.maxed: This piece has reached +20 — a masterpiece.
forge.noneLeft: The furnace needs to cool until tomorrow.
forge.noItems: Nothing in the backpack to work with.
arena.title: The Arena
arena.subtitle: Ten rewarded bouts a day. Bruises are complimentary.
arena.cooldown: Catch your breath — next bout in {time}
arena.sparringBanner: Today's purse is spent — everything from here is sparring. No rewards, no risk, unlimited bragging.
arena.milestonesDone: Every rank milestone claimed. The ladder bows.
arena.tieBreak: The hourglass ran out — the judges gave it to the defender.
arena.reward.chest: An Arena Chest tumbles off the prize shelf!
arena.reward.chestSold: Backpack full — the clerk flogged the chest for {gold} gold.
arena.reward.sparNote: Sparring bout — nothing gained, nothing lost, honor intact.
hall.title: Hall of Fame
hall.subtitle: Every name in the realm, ranked by honor. Yours included.
hall.noMatch: No one by that name. Perhaps they rage-quit.
boss.squeaker.name: Squeaker the Bold
boss.squeaker.intro: I have bitten larger ankles than yours. Present them.
boss.twitchwhisker.name: Twitchwhisker
boss.twitchwhisker.intro: You blinked first. You will blink again.
boss.cheese-baron.name: The Cheese Baron
boss.cheese-baron.intro: Every wheel in this cellar is spoken for. Including yours.
boss.gnawbone.name: Gnawbone
boss.gnawbone.intro: Your femur looks load-bearing. Let's test that.
boss.rattigan-prime.name: Rattigan Prime
boss.rattigan-prime.intro: The other rats voted. It was unanimous. Sorry.
boss.under-butler.name: The Under-Butler
boss.under-butler.intro: I regret to inform you that you are not on the list.
boss.mold-king-sporus.name: Mold King Sporus
boss.mold-king-sporus.intro: Breathe deep, adventurer. My kingdom is airborne.
boss.whiskered-widow.name: The Whiskered Widow
boss.whiskered-widow.intro: My last eight suitors are load-bearing furniture now.
boss.tunnel-tyrant.name: Tunnel Tyrant
boss.tunnel-tyrant.intro: This tunnel has a toll. The toll is everything.
boss.rat-kings-rat.name: The Rat King's Rat
boss.rat-kings-rat.intro: The Rat King keeps a rat. It has always been me. Kneel.
boss.barnacle-bishop.name: Barnacle Bishop
boss.barnacle-bishop.intro: I bless in salt and I sink in style. Approach the font.
boss.damp-deacon.name: The Damp Deacon
boss.damp-deacon.intro: The sermon is moisture. The congregation is you.
boss.coffin-bobber.name: Coffin Bobber
boss.coffin-bobber.intro: Some coffins float. Mine floats best. Get in.
boss.silt-prophet.name: Silt Prophet
boss.silt-prophet.intro: I read your future in the mud. It's mud.
boss.abbess-of-algae.name: Abbess of Algae
boss.abbess-of-algae.intro: Photosynthesis is a prayer, and I am devout.
boss.pickled-knight.name: The Pickled Knight
boss.pickled-knight.intro: Four hundred years in brine and STILL sharper than you.
boss.choir-of-bubbles.name: Choir of Bubbles
boss.choir-of-bubbles.intro: Our hymn has one note, and you're about to hear all of it.
boss.reliquary-crab.name: Reliquary Crab
boss.reliquary-crab.intro: These relics chose me. Mostly because I pinched everyone else.
boss.drowned-sexton.name: Drowned Sexton
boss.drowned-sexton.intro: I dig graves underwater. Yours is taking on water nicely.
boss.saint-mildew.name: Saint Mildew
boss.saint-mildew.intro: Sainthood takes patience. I've been spreading for centuries.
boss.root-bound-golem.name: Root-Bound Golem
boss.root-bound-golem.intro: The forest said no. I am the paperwork.
boss.sap-countess.name: The Sap Countess
boss.sap-countess.intro: Everything sticks to me eventually. You look no different.
boss.burrow-baron.name: Burrow Baron
boss.burrow-baron.intro: You are standing in my foyer. The exits are grief.
boss.compost-horror.name: Compost Horror
boss.compost-horror.intro: Everything returns to the soil. You're ahead of schedule.
boss.ironbark-alpha.name: Ironbark Alpha
boss.ironbark-alpha.intro: The pack howls. The trees howl back. Guess which I am.
boss.gilded-beetle.name: The Gilded Beetle
boss.gilded-beetle.intro: Yes, it's real gold. No, you may not touch it.
boss.fungal-parliament.name: Fungal Parliament
boss.fungal-parliament.intro: The motion to devour you passed without debate.
boss.tremor-worm.name: Tremor Worm
boss.tremor-worm.intro: That rumble isn't thunder, and it isn't far.
boss.deep-gardener.name: The Deep Gardener
boss.deep-gardener.intro: I planted everything you walked past. Including the traps.
boss.heartwood-regent.name: Heartwood Regent
boss.heartwood-regent.intro: This throne grew around me. Removal is not on the table.
boss.glasswork-sentinel.name: Glasswork Sentinel
boss.glasswork-sentinel.intro: Mind the floor. It was my predecessor.
boss.mirror-twin.name: The Mirror Twin
boss.mirror-twin.intro: You'll fight the better-looking one of us. That's both.
boss.stair-warden.name: Stair Warden
boss.stair-warden.intro: Nine hundred steps and you're winded? This bodes well. For me.
boss.volcanic-scribe.name: Volcanic Scribe
boss.volcanic-scribe.intro: Your obituary is drafted. I write in lava, so no edits.
boss.archivist-of-ash.name: The Archivist of Ash
boss.archivist-of-ash.intro: Everything burns eventually. I file the everything.
boss.smoke-chamberlain.name: Smoke Chamberlain
boss.smoke-chamberlain.intro: The Spire receives you. Exhale while you still choose to.
boss.molten-aviary.name: The Molten Aviary
boss.molten-aviary.intro: The birds are lava. I cannot stress this enough.
boss.spire-inquisitor.name: Spire Inquisitor
boss.spire-inquisitor.intro: First question: why are you here? Wrong answer.
boss.penultimate-door.name: The Penultimate Door
boss.penultimate-door.intro: I am not the last door. But you'll wish I had been.
boss.magnus-vitrified.name: Magnus Vitrified
boss.magnus-vitrified.intro: I looked into the volcano and the volcano blinked. Your turn.
boss.gatekeeper-morrow.name: Gatekeeper Morrow
boss.gatekeeper-morrow.intro: The Court sees you. The Court is unimpressed. Enter anyway.
boss.bone-sommelier.name: The Bone Sommelier
boss.bone-sommelier.intro: An excellent vintage, your marrow. May I?
boss.pale-jester.name: Pale Jester
boss.pale-jester.intro: The King never laughs. Imagine my job security.
boss.twin-regents.name: Twin Regents
boss.twin-regents.intro: We rule alternate Tuesdays. Today we both showed up. For you.
boss.queens-echo.name: The Queen's Echo
boss.queens-echo.intro: She said goodbye once. I've been saying it ever since.
boss.master-of-hounds.name: Master of Hounds
boss.master-of-hounds.intro: The hounds are invisible. The teeth, regrettably, are not.
boss.unlit-chandelier.name: The Unlit Chandelier
boss.unlit-chandelier.intro: A thousand candles, none lit. Warmth left this hall with her.
boss.chancellor-vane.name: Chancellor Vane
boss.chancellor-vane.intro: Your petition to leave alive has been… tabled.
boss.kings-conscience.name: The King's Conscience
boss.kings-conscience.intro: He locked me down here. Tells you everything, doesn't it?
boss.the-pale-king.name: The Pale King
boss.the-pale-king.intro: You climbed far to disappoint me in person. Court is in session.
miniboss.captain-flotsam.name: Captain Flotsam
miniboss.captain-flotsam.intro: Everything the tide takes belongs to me. You count as taken.
miniboss.crystal-curator.name: The Crystal Curator
miniboss.crystal-curator.intro: Please don't touch the exhibits. You're about to BE one.
miniboss.sergeant-nap.name: Sergeant Nap
miniboss.sergeant-nap.intro: You woke me for THIS? Someone fetch my halberd.
miniboss.pinewatch-impostor.name: The Pinewatch Impostor
miniboss.pinewatch-impostor.intro: I've watched this forest for years. The real watchman? Also me. Shh.
exped.event.0.prompt: A merchant's cart is axle-deep in the mud, and his patience is deeper still.
exped.event.0.safeOut: He pays you mostly to stop negotiating.
exped.event.0.boldOut: Your back learns things no book teaches.
exped.event.1.prompt: A mossy shrine hums under the ferns, faintly annoyed at being found.
exped.event.1.safeOut: The carvings rearrange themselves into a lesson.
exped.event.1.boldOut: The bowl was full. The guilt is fuller.
exped.event.2.prompt: A lost lamb has decided, unilaterally, that you are its shepherd now.
exped.event.2.safeOut: The real shepherd salutes you across the valley.
exped.event.2.boldOut: It headbutts a bandit's shin. You feel invincible.
exped.event.3.prompt: The bridge toll is collected by a troll with a ledger and strong opinions.
exped.event.3.safeOut: He refunds you out of sheer embarrassment.
exped.event.3.boldOut: The troll applauds. The ledger weeps.
exped.event.4.prompt: A message bottle bobs at the shoreline, cork sealed with optimism.
exped.event.4.safeOut: Collectors pay well for good glass.
exped.event.4.boldOut: X marks a modest but very educational spot.
exped.event.5.prompt: An old duelist polishes a bench with his coat and offers you a lesson.
exped.event.5.safeOut: Footwork, it turns out, is everything.
exped.event.5.boldOut: He pays up, wheezing with laughter.
exped.event.6.prompt: A campfire crackles beside three empty seats and one raised eyebrow.
exped.event.6.bold: Tell the tale of your deeds
exped.event.6.safeOut: Travelers remember kindness longer than gold.
exped.event.6.boldOut: By dawn the story has somehow grown a dragon.
exped.event.7.prompt: A locked strongbox sits half-buried, wearing a 'REWARD IF FOUND' notice.
exped.event.7.bold: Haul it uphill to its owner
exped.event.7.safeOut: The notice board pays out, no questions.
exped.event.7.boldOut: Her thanks echo for miles. So does your spine.
exped.event.8.prompt: A ring of mushrooms, suspiciously perfect, dares you to acknowledge it.
exped.event.8.safeOut: Alchemists buy anything arranged in a circle.
exped.event.8.boldOut: Nothing happens. You learn exactly what folklore is worth.
exped.event.9.prompt: A scarecrow stands at attention, wearing a general's coat far above its rank.
exped.event.9.boldOut: The crows invoice you. You keep the coat anyway.
exped.event.10.prompt: The rope bridge is fine. Except for the plank. The missing one. Mid-span.
exped.event.10.safeOut: The next traveler will never know the danger.
exped.event.10.boldOut: The gorge echoes your triumph twice.
exped.event.11.prompt: A tax collector sits on a stump, mourning a ledger the wind took.
exped.event.11.bold: Retrieve it and keep his secret
exped.event.11.safeOut: He pays quickly and very quietly.
exped.event.11.boldOut: The whole village toasts your discretion.
exped.event.12.prompt: Someone has installed a beehive in the mailbox. The mail disagrees.
exped.event.12.boldOut: The postmaster weeps with gratitude and teaches you the routes.
exped.event.13.prompt: A star chart is carved into a stump, oriented for someone much shorter.
exped.event.13.boldOut: A passing astronomer overpays on the spot.
exped.event.14.prompt: Two snails are dueling in the middle of the path. It is day three.
exped.event.14.safeOut: Patience is its own quiet reward.
exped.event.14.boldOut: Both snails salute you. The crowd goes mild.
exped.event.15.prompt: A wishing puddle glimmers — the budget option, but the coppers are real.
exped.event.15.boldOut: You feel… slightly grander. Hard to explain.
exped.event.16.prompt: A minstrel cradles a lute with one string left and two verses to go.
exped.event.16.safeOut: He pays in exact change and excellent gossip.
exped.event.16.boldOut: The chorus stays with you — verse, lesson and all.
exped.event.17.prompt: An abandoned watchtower leans invitingly, door ajar, bell intact.
exped.event.17.boldOut: A startled pigeon drops a coin purse. Somehow.
exped.event.18.prompt: A farmer sprints past you, pursued by the concept of a runaway pig.
exped.event.18.safe: Head it off at the gate
exped.event.19.prompt: The crossroads signpost is wrong in three directions and rude in the fourth.
exped.event.19.safe: Correct it for the town fee
exped.event.19.boldOut: Travelers will smile at that corner for years.
exped.event.20.prompt: Tide pools glitter with shells and the occasional judgmental crab.
exped.event.20.safeOut: A jeweler pays by the dozen.
exped.event.20.boldOut: Sideways is a valid tactic. Noted forever.
exped.event.21.prompt: A hedge maze offers a shortcut. The hedge has heard that one before.
exped.event.21.boldOut: He knows the turns, but you know sprinting. He pays up.
exped.event.22.prompt: A stray dog guards a doorway with the gravity of a sworn knight.
exped.event.22.safeOut: A friend for a mile. Worth every crumb.
exped.event.22.boldOut: Whatever's in there stays in there. Heroic.
exped.event.23.prompt: Rain arrives ahead of schedule; a caravan's canvas has other plans.
exped.event.23.bold: Hold the canvas through the storm
quests.title: The Quest Board
quests.subtitle: Marla pins the notices up every morning. Some of them are even legible.
quests.empty: The board is bare. Come back after a night's sleep.
quests.activityHint: Fill the meter to open the Daily Chest.
quests.lockedHint: The quest board opens at level {level}.
quests.reward.title: a title
story.title: The Ballad of Brambleford
story.allDone: The ballad rests here… until the next patch.
achv.title: Achievements
achv.subtitle: Proof, in writing, that you did the thing.
achv.attrSummary: Achievements grant you +{n} to every attribute.
codex.title: The Codex
codex.subtitle: Everything you have met, catalogued and grudgingly respected.
codex.loreLocked: Defeat {n} more to learn its story.
codex.lockedHint: The Codex is shelved until level {level}.
calendar.title: The Innkeeper's Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Marla marks the days. Miss one and the board simply waits.
calendar.lockedHint: The calendar goes up at level {level}.
calendar.complete: The whole month, stamped. Marla is impressed.
title.pickerHint: Earned through achievements, the ballad, and the arena.
dungeons.title: The Dungeons
dungeons.subtitle: Five locked doors, fifty names behind them. Attempts are free; humility is included.
dungeon.lockedCard: The door ignores you. Come back at level {level}.
dungeon.reward.wing: {dungeon} conquered. The door stays open out of respect.
dungeon.wall.title: The wall holds.
dungeon.wall.armor: Their armor shrugged off {pct}% of your damage. Strength, upgrades, or both.
dungeon.wall.hp: You carved away {pct}% of that health bar. Grow, then collect the rest.
dungeon.wall.close: {pct}% left standing. That wasn't a wall, that was a curtain — again!
exped.title: Expeditions
exped.subtitle: Twenty-five vigor, five choices, one chest. Being present pays.
exped.reasonVigor: Not enough vigor — the tavern kitchen can help.
exped.reasonLimit: The roads have seen enough of you today.
exped.tierMax: Gold chest secured — the good one
exped.abandoned: The run is abandoned. The chest sighs, unopened.
wheel.title: The Wheel of Destiny
wheel.subtitle: Lorenzo the Improbable guarantees nothing, loudly.
wheel.bark.0: Round and round she goes — destiny hates a coward!
wheel.bark.1: The wheel is honest. Unlike, historically, me!
wheel.bark.mystery: MYSTERY! The wheel spins the wheel! Doubled!
wheel.bark.jackpot: STOP EVERYTHING. THE WHEEL HAS CHOSEN.
wheel.bark.salute: The wheel salutes you. That is… that's the whole prize.
wheel.result.treats: +{n} pet treats (the pets arrive later — the treats keep)
menagerie.title: The Menagerie
menagerie.subtitle: Fenn keeps the ledger. The animals keep their own counsel.
menagerie.locked: Fenn's back room stays shut until chapter five of the ballad — level {level}.
menagerie.empty: No companions yet. Missions, dungeons and the well all keep one.
menagerie.fedLevels: Fed to level up ×{n}. Deeply satisfied.
menagerie.source.wheel: The Wheel's jackpot, and nowhere else
menagerie.found: {name} has decided to come with you.
stable.title: The Stable
stable.subtitle: Wilbur Hay, four stalls, and one of them downwind.
stable.locked: Wilbur won't rent to anyone under level {level}. Insurance.
well.title: The Wishing Well
well.subtitle: Something down there sorts your coins by rarity.
well.locked: The well is boarded over until level {level}. For everyone's sake.
well.odds: The odds, posted by the bucket
well.pityHitEpic: Pity: the well owed you an Epic.
well.pityHitSet: Pity: the well owed you a set piece.
well.featuredNote: Three in four set pieces come from {set}.
well.freeToday: Your free daily toss is still waiting.
ob.skipped: Skipped ahead. Brambleford will pretend you were always here.
ob.cold-open.title: A broken cart, and a wave
ob.cold-open.body: Your cart gave out on the road, one hill short of Brambleford. The innkeeper is already waving you in — she has seen a great many people arrive exactly like this.
ob.first-mission.title: Take a job from the board
ob.first-mission.body: The tavern board always holds three. Pick one, spend the vigor, and let it run — the timer keeps going whether or not you are watching.
ob.first-equip.title: Put it on
ob.first-equip.body: Anything you find lands in the backpack. Tap a piece to equip it; anything you will never wear is worth gold at a merchant.
ob.first-attribute.title: The bottomless sink
ob.first-attribute.body: Gold buys attribute points, and the next one always costs more than the last. There is no cap and no finish line — this is where every coin you ever earn eventually goes.
ob.first-arena.title: Krellbor is overconfident
ob.first-arena.body: Ten bouts a day. Winning takes honour from the loser and moves you up the hall; losing costs a little. Krellbor has been asking for this.
ob.town-reveal.title: Brambleford, then
ob.town-reveal.body: That is the whole loop: take work, come back richer, spend it, climb. The rest of the town opens as you grow — and the ballad will take it from here.
tour.title: First time here
tour.patrol: When your vigor runs out, walk the walls instead. Patrol trickles gold and experience for up to eight hours, and banks itself at midnight — it is what the night is for.
tour.arena: Ten rewarded bouts a day against the hall. Fighting UP is where the climb lives: beating someone above you takes their place, and losing to them costs little.
tour.shops: Six items a day per merchant, refreshed at reset. The first re-roll is free; after that it costs gems, so spend the free one first.
tour.forge: Scraps and dust from dismantled gear go here. Upgrading a piece raises every stat on it — worth doing to gear you intend to keep for a while.
tour.dungeons: Five wings, ten bosses each, one free attempt an hour. Bouncing off a floor is not failure, it is the measurement — come back when your numbers are bigger.
tour.expeditions: A five-step run of choices for 25 vigor. Bold picks pay more heroism and heroism decides the chest at the end. Losing a fight never ends the run.
tour.wheel: Five spins a day, the first free and the rest at rising gold. It costs more gold than it returns on purpose — you spin it for the items, gems and treats.
tour.quests: Three dailies, three weeklies, two month-long marathons. Every daily also fills the Activity meter, and a full meter is its own chest.
tour.achievements: Seventy feats, most of them tiered. Every tier you claim is +3 to all attributes, permanently — this screen is a real part of your power curve.
tour.codex: Monsters fill in as you meet them, gear as you find it. Completed pages pay standing gold-find and experience, so the Codex pays you for exploring.
tour.calendar: One stamp a day, twenty-eight days a month. Missing a day costs you that day and nothing else — the streak is not a punishment mechanic.
tour.hallOfFame: Seven hundred and fifty names, all of them climbing while you are away. Tap anyone to see the hero behind the row.
tour.stable: A mount shortens every mission you will ever run, permanently. Upgrading pays only the difference, so the ladder is never wasted gold.
tour.menagerie: One pet walks with you and its auras grow as you feed it treats. But every pet you merely OWN adds to all your attributes — collecting matters on its own.
tour.well: The odds and the pity counters are on this screen at all times, deliberately. Gems are earned in-game and cannot be bought with money — there is no shop here and never will be.
help.title: {screen} — how it works
pwa.install.title: Pin Aethermoor to your home screen?
pwa.install.body: SimpleRPG can live on your home screen and open like any other app — same hero, same save, no account, and it still works with the signal off.
pwa.update.title: A new patch has arrived at the gates
pwa.update.body: A newer version of the game is waiting. Reloading takes a moment and changes nothing about your hero — your save lives on this device either way.
